```{r}
visit <- data.frame(
  id = rep(sprintf("P%02d", 1:6), each = 2),
  arm = rep(rep(c("control", "treated"), each = 3), each = 2),
  grade = rep(c("mild", "moderate", "severe",
                "mild", "moderate", "severe"), each = 2),
  week = rep(c(0, 4), 6),
  marker = c(4.1, 4.4, 5.0, NA, 4.6, 4.8,
             5.2, 4.6, 6.0, 5.1, 5.6, NA)
)

# Supplied so the lab can focus on matrix behavior rather than reshaping syntax.
marker_matrix <- matrix(
  visit$marker,
  nrow = 6,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(sprintf("P%02d", 1:6), c("week0", "week4"))
)
```
